findings.description: The new upgrade steps say "delete the workflow, re-run `npx agentspine`", but `--packs` defaults to none and is never remembered, so that bare command emits neither the workflow nor the `pr-ci-review` skill and leaves the repository with no CI review (CHANGELOG.md:6-8 repeats it).
findings.body:
**The documented upgrade path removes the CI review rather than upgrading it.**

The fix replaces "Re-scaffold to move that pin" with a literal command: "delete the workflow, re-run `npx agentspine`". The scaffolder takes its packs only from the CLI. Nothing on disk records which packs a repository was scaffolded with:

- `parse()` starts at `packs: []` (`src/cli.ts:56`), and only `--packs` changes it (`:80-86`).
- `resolvePacks` (`src/plan.utils.ts:36-45`) expands the requested list only. It never detects an existing `.agents/skills/pr-ci-review` or a marker.
- The workflow is emitted only `if (packs.includes("ci-review"))` ([src/plan.utils.ts:292](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/agentspine/blob/94f1a8bb6c35aff15ca0ce11068de26879b66b03/src/plan.utils.ts#L292-L301)), and pack skills are copied only for requested packs (`:278-284`).

Someone who follows the README literally deletes `.github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml`, runs `npx agentspine`, gets core content only, and ends up with no review workflow. For the same reason, line 140's "A re-scaffold updates the `pr-ci-review` skill" holds only when `--packs ci-review` is passed again.

Two more snags lie on the corrected path:

- The deletion leaves the tree dirty (`gitState` treats any `git status --porcelain` output as dirty, `src/detect.utils.ts:67-68`), so `init` refuses until it is committed or `--force` is passed (`src/cli.ts:107-110`).
- Passing `--packs` makes the run non-interactive (`src/cli.ts:64`, `:124`), so it also needs `--yes`, or it exits at "Refusing to write without confirmation" (`:161-164`).

`CHANGELOG.md:6-8` gives the same bare command and needs the same fix.

- [README.md#L140-L142](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/agentspine/blob/94f1a8bb6c35aff15ca0ce11068de26879b66b03/README.md#L140-L142)
- [CHANGELOG.md#L6-L8](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/agentspine/blob/94f1a8bb6c35aff15ca0ce11068de26879b66b03/CHANGELOG.md#L6-L8)
findings.suggestion:
toolchain of its own. Re-running with `--packs ci-review` updates the `pr-ci-review` skill but never
rewrites an existing workflow, though the skill, the workflow and the tooling move together. To
upgrade, delete the workflow and commit that, re-run `npx agentspine --packs ci-review --yes` with
every other pack you use, then re-apply any edits you had made to it.

findings.description: "the two move together with the tooling" is ambiguous: the sentence names the skill, the workflow and the tooling, so a reader can't tell what "the two" is. The workflow comment's "this workflow, the pr-ci-review skill and the poster share a contract" is clearer.

The decision 23 amendment says only deleting or editing the workflow moves the pin. It leaves out the cost the README and the workflow comment state: a re-scaffold that skips the workflow still updates the skill, so the skill and the pinned tooling can diverge.

process_issues.description: .claude-pr/ again held only CLAUDE.md, .gitmodules and .claude/. The PR's copies of the RESTORE_PATHS entries (AGENTS.md, .agents, templates) were missing, so reviewers read them with `git show HEAD:<path>`. One conventions note relied on the in-tree base copy of templates/ for the pin and did not read the head.

Skipped security and context: in this delta the workflow template changes only a comment, and the rest is docs plus a test helper, so no trust boundary or protocol surface changed. Skipped spec: there is no closing keyword or linked issue.
